settings.title: DELIVERY
settings.content:
MAINLAND UK + NORTHERN IRELAND

Free Mainland UK Delivery within 1-7 Business Days. We will contact you with advance notice to organise a delivery date.

Free Northern Ireland Delivery within 14-21 Business Days. We will contact you with advance notice to organise a delivery date.

NORTH WEST

Free Express 1-3 Business Days to the following post codes:

BL, L, M, OL, SK, WA, WN.



LONDON

Free Express 1-4 Business Days to the following post codes:

NW, N, E, SE, SW, W, WC, EC, WD, EN, IG, BR, CR, SM, KT, TW, UB, HA.



Remainder of the UK

Free UK Delivery within 1-9 Business Days to the following post codes:.

AB, BA, CA, DD, DG, DT, EX, FK, IP, IV1, IV2, IV3, IV5, IV8, IV9, IV10, IV12, IV13, IV30, IV31, IV32, IV36, KY, LA, LD, LL, LN, NR, PE, PH1-PH26, PL, SA, SY, TA, TQ, TR




PRE ORDER ITEM(S) DELIVERY

Your Pre Order item(s) will be delivered to you with the utmost urgency within the advised shipping week. You can easily locate the shipping week above the 'ADD TO CART' button.

Our highly acclaimed Pre Order service is available for customers who wish to purchase and reserve in demand stock.

Cancel anytime. 100% refund guarantee.



ORDERS OF IN STOCK AND PRE ORDER ITEM(S)

In this case we will ship your in stock item(s) to you within the standard delivery time. Once your Pre Order item(s) arrive in stock, we'll deliver these to you as fast as possible.

settings.title: Returns
settings.content:
We offer 90 Days Free Returns on all orders. To start a return, head to your Customer Portal and select 'Request a return' or, simply email hello@williamwoodmirrors.co.uk with your order number. Our Customer Support Team will respond to your request as soon as possible and confirm the next steps.


INDUSTRY LEADING REFUND TIMES

Once returning item(s) have been collected by your William Wood Dedicated driver, your payment will be refunded back to your original payment method within 1 working day - That's our promise.

For in depth information on Returns & Exchanges, tap here.

Require further assistance? Contact our Customer Support Team via hello@williamwoodmirrors.co.uk and an advisor will be pleased to assist you.

settings.title: ROOM OF CHOICE DELIVERY
settings.content:
DELIVERY TO FRONT ENTRANCE OF YOUR PROPERTY

William Wood Dedicated Delivery service will hand deliver your item(s) with the utmost care to the front entrance of your property.


DELIVERY TO SPECIFIC ROOM OF CHOICE WITHIN YOUR PROPERTY

With a large majority of cases, William Wood Dedicated Delivery service will be able to deliver your item(s) to your room of choice. However, upon inspecting the path to your specific room of choice and whether this may be to difficult, this decision will be at the William Wood Dedicated Delivery drivers discretion.

Require further assistance? Contact our Customer Support Team via hello@williamwoodmirrors.co.uk and an advisor will be pleased to assist you.

settings.title: Customer Support
settings.content:
Require assistance? Contact our Customer Support Team via hello@williamwoodmirrors.co.uk and an advisor will be pleased to assist you. Contact us here - /pages/contact-us


RESPONSE TIMES

Most inquiries are handled within a matter of hours, however please allow up to 1-2 working days for a response during busy periods.

settings.title: Do you ship overseas?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship all over the world. Shipping costs will apply, and will be added at checkout. We run discounts and promotions all year, so stay tuned for exclusive deals.

settings.title: How long will it take to get my order?
settings.answer: It depends on where you are. Orders processed here will take 5-7 business days to arrive. Overseas deliveries can take anywhere from 7-16 days. Delivery details will be provided in your confirmation email.

settings.title: Any question?
settings.answer: You can contact us through our contact page! We will be happy to assist you.
